items.title: docs: audit fixed I6-A, sdist and C0 parallel stack (Task B)
items.body:
The reviewed I6-A, minimal-sdist and C0-E1 siblings share #133 but have never been accepted as one executable tree. This Draft records their actual DAG, conflicts, bounded combined-tree verification and remaining integration obligations. It publishes documentation/evidence and one reusable procedural skill only; no product integration branch is published and no existing PR/base or accepted ADR is changed.

- Fixed review pins: #149 `ea43a21fca1dbf8fa6dd1c254b28a96d5dd28d00`, #144 `ededcd83eb2d99a602ba18c8fe3c177125c825ac`, #147 `e7762952e18061de8c8235beaeddf42f20ad9f5a`; all API/object trees verified twice. Actual common merge-base is #133 `f16e5b1713bde9a2f18263a25397c4b450fd5773`.
- Six shared files, two textual conflicts; preserving both changes in all six simulated orders reaches tree `2c61c7d79bf9a95c4f04ccdbda8fae1fe15d5491`. A separate non-author reconstruction agrees. Current main's distinct topology is also checked; its merge-tree returns that same candidate.
- Candidate source: **562 passed**. Each installed direct/derived wheel: **290 I6-focused + 217 I4 + 29 I5 passed**, exact collection/JUnit/journal/import binding. Original Access smoke remains **exit 1 / PERMISSION_DENIED** on both forms; overall existing distribution driver remains **exit 1**. This matches the frozen I6-A failure, not the older Transfer refusal.
- All current **158 product files**, including SQL/JSON/GraphQL, survive. Combined minimal sdist **690,942 bytes**; full direct/derived wheel/metadata/RECORD equality and backend-only rebuild pass. Historical 155-file/677,902-byte measurements are not fixed future targets.
- **32** one-file routing cases pass across snapshots/combined candidate. #148 Access omission is a documented coverage limitation; a violated lightweight development contract was not established, so no speculative CI repair PR is created.
- Recommendation: C0-E1 → sdist → I6-A, then re-freeze/review I6-B before any conditional basic I8-A parallel work. Transfer Query/Search acceptance waits reviewed C/I7 and integrated tests. Both Transfer fences remain mandatory. #119/#137 are historical scoped evidence, not current acceptance.

The independent evidence/prose/artifact review is **PASS for this documentary submission**, with no unresolved material finding. The source inventory contains 6,229 ordinary nodes; **5,667 ordinary source nodes**, one live and one benchmark remain unexecuted from source in this audit. Installed repeats are reported separately. No full Release acceptance, hosted combined Access overflow/upload experiment, normal Transfer, merge, release, deployment or fence retirement is claimed.

Local/installed execution used the selected CPython 3.12.14 and its actual built-in SQLite 3.53.1; real safety/STRICT/JSON/FTS5/WAL checks pass. No SQLite acquisition/build/replacement or matrix. All setup/harness failures and original nonzero results are retained in indexed evidence. Final selected hosted CI is verified separately against this publication HEAD in the final handoff; Development Success is not complete Release acceptance.

Publication: base `fix/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022` at `f16e5b1713bde9a2f18263a25397c4b450fd5773`; head `audit/parallel-pr-stack-task-b-20261023` at `4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7`; tree `9a5ab4a58763055999fdf5eab971d1f1b4c7998d`.

[Audit and evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7/docs/implementation/evidence/parallel-stack-task-b-20261023/README.md) · [Integration/retest plan](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7/docs/implementation/evidence/parallel-stack-task-b-20261023/PLAN.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7/docs/implementation/evidence/parallel-stack-task-b-20261023/INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.md) · [Raw indexed evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7/docs/implementation/evidence/parallel-stack-task-b-20261023/raw-evidence-index.json) · [Archive integrity](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/4fc00b1fbc57f10f6c0c6352dee702e1738f65b7/docs/implementation/evidence/parallel-stack-task-b-20261023/raw/archive-verification.json).
